name: What are the advantages of choosing casement windows for my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of choosing casement windows for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Casement windows offer several benefits, including excellent ventilation as they open wide, often up to 90 degrees, allowing for maximum airflow. Their sashes press tightly against the frame when closed, providing superior energy efficiency and a good seal against drafts compared to some other window types. They also offer clear, unobstructed views and are generally easy to operate with a crank mechanism. When considering casement windows, think about the placement of furniture or landscaping that might obstruct the outward swing of the window sash.
